hindi: अहंमात्रवाद — केवल अपने मन को ही निश्चित रूप से वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view that only your own mind is certainly real, and that everything else might exist only inside your experience
example: After three hours of gaming alone, Rohan joked that his solipsism was confirmed: nobody had texted, so maybe nobody else existed.

hindi: वाद — कोई भी विशिष्ट सिद्धांत या विचारधारा
definition: an informal word for any distinctive doctrine, theory or belief system, borrowed from the ending of names like realism, stoicism and socialism
example: Priya's uncle has an ism for everything, and by dessert he had blamed the traffic on three of them.

hindi: निरस्तीकरण — राज्य द्वारा संघीय कानून को अपने यहाँ अमान्य ठहराने का सिद्धांत
definition: the political doctrine that a member state may declare a national or federal statute invalid within its own borders and refuse to enforce it
example: In civics class, Meera argued that nullification would turn the country into a group project where every member ignores the rubric.

hindi: गतिवाद — जगत को भीतर सक्रिय शक्ति या ऊर्जा से समझाने का मत
definition: any theory that explains the natural world through forces or energy active inside things, rather than through passive, lifeless matter
example: Watching the pressure cooker rattle on the stove, Kabir declared himself a convert to dynamism: clearly the dal had energy of its own.

hindi: आदेशवाद — नैतिक कथनों को तथ्य नहीं, आचरण के निर्देश मानने का मत
definition: the view in ethics that moral statements work like instructions, telling people what to do rather than describing facts about the world
example: Anika's prescriptivism shows in the flat group chat, where 'stealing yogurt is wrong' really just means 'hands off my yogurt'.

hindi: लोकहितवाद — दुखी मनुष्यों की भलाई को अपना कर्तव्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that people have a duty to reduce human suffering and improve the welfare of others, whoever and wherever they are
example: Her humanitarianism is practical: she skipped the debate about global poverty and set up a monthly donation before lunch.

hindi: विधेय — वाक्य में उद्देश्य के बारे में कही गई बात
definition: in logic, the part of a statement that says something about its subject, such as 'is mortal' in 'Socrates is mortal'
example: In 'the chai is too sweet', the predicate is 'too sweet', and it is also Nani's entire review.

hindi: नामवाद — सामान्य गुणों को केवल नाम मानने का मत
definition: the view that general ideas such as redness or justice are only names we apply, and that only particular, individual things really exist
example: Arguing over whether a hot dog is a sandwich, Dev took the nominalism route: there is no sandwich essence, just things we choose to call sandwiches.

hindi: बुद्धिवाद — ज्ञान का मुख्य स्रोत तर्कबुद्धि को मानने का मत
definition: the view that reason, rather than sensory experience, is the main source of knowledge, and that some truths can be known by thinking alone
example: Her rationalism kicked in during the quiz: she had never seen a square circle, yet knew without looking that none could exist.

hindi: आश्रित पद — अकेले अर्थ न रखकर दूसरे शब्दों के सहारे अर्थ देने वाला
definition: describing a word, like 'every', 'never' or 'and', that has no meaning standing alone and works only when joined with other words
example: The group chat reply 'and?' fell flat, because a syncategorematic word cannot carry a whole conversation by itself.

hindi: संदर्भवाद — अर्थ और सत्य को संदर्भ पर निर्भर मानने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning or truth of a statement, especially a claim to know something, depends on the situation in which it is made
example: 'I know where my keys are' sounds fine at home but shaky at the airport, which is contextualism in a nutshell.

hindi: विखंडनवाद — पाठ में छिपे अंतर्विरोध खोजने वाली आलोचना-परंपरा
definition: the school of criticism, begun by Jacques Derrida, holding that every text hides contradictions and that its meaning is never fully fixed
example: Two weeks into deconstructionism, Tara could no longer read a cereal box without finding a hidden war between 'natural' and 'flavoured'.

hindi: जीववाद — प्रकृति की वस्तुओं में आत्मा मानने का विश्वास
definition: the belief that natural things such as rivers, trees, animals and mountains possess a soul or spirit of their own
example: When Grandma thanks the neem tree each morning, she is practising a quiet animism her village has kept for generations.

hindi: विधेयन — किसी विषय पर कोई गुण आरोपित करने की क्रिया
definition: in logic, the action of saying that some quality or property belongs to a subject, as when a sentence calls the soup cold
example: 'Monday is exhausting' is a predication the whole office would sign without reading.

hindi: अरस्तूवाद — अरस्तू और टहलते हुए पढ़ाने वाली उनकी परंपरा का दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Aristotle and his followers, covering logic, nature, ethics and politics, named after his habit of teaching while walking
example: The professor's peripateticism is literal: she lectures on ethics while pacing the corridor, and the back row follows with laptops open.

hindi: उपयोगितावाद — अधिकतम लोगों के अधिकतम सुख को नैतिक कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the view that the right action is whichever choice produces the greatest total happiness for the greatest number of people
example: Ordering the pizza everyone could tolerate instead of the one Arjun loved was pure utilitarianism, and Arjun sulked all evening.

hindi: परस्पर-विनिमेय — अर्थ या सत्य बदले बिना एक-दूसरे की जगह रखे जा सकने वाले
definition: in logic, able to swap places without changing whether a statement is true, as with two names for the same thing
example: In the quiz, 'Mumbai' and 'Bombay' were interchangeable, so Neha scored the point either way.

hindi: सौंदर्यशास्त्र — सौंदर्य, रुचि और कला के मूल्यांकन का दर्शन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies beauty, taste and artistic value, asking what makes something beautiful and how we judge artworks; also spelled esthetics
example: The canteen debate over whether a banana taped to a wall counts as art was aesthetics, whether anyone called it that or not.

hindi: तर्कमूलक — अंतर्ज्ञान से नहीं, क्रमबद्ध तर्क से निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने वाला
definition: reaching a conclusion step by step through reasoning and argument, rather than grasping it all at once by intuition
example: Geometry proofs are discursive: you cannot just feel that the angles add up, you have to walk there line by line.

hindi: नियतिवाद — हर घटना को पूर्व कारणों से अनिवार्यतः तय मानने का मत
definition: the view that every event, including human choices, is fixed in advance by earlier causes, which many think leaves no room for free will
example: Blaming determinism for eating the last samosa did not impress his sister, who had causes of her own for being angry.

hindi: प्रकृतिवाद — जगत को अलौकिक शक्तियों के बिना, प्राकृतिक कारणों से समझने का मत
definition: the view that everything can be explained by natural causes and scientific study, without appeal to spirits or supernatural powers
example: When the lights flickered, Aisha's naturalism sent her straight to the fuse box while her cousin was still listening for footsteps.

hindi: वर्तमानवाद — केवल वर्तमान को ही वास्तविक मानने का मत
definition: the view in philosophy of time that only present things truly exist, while the past no longer exists and the future does not exist yet
example: Stuck in traffic, Vikram adopted presentism: yesterday's plans were gone, tomorrow's meeting wasn't real, and only this red light existed.

hindi: नारीवाद — स्त्रियों के समान अधिकारों और अवसरों का समर्थन करने वाला मत
definition: the movement and body of ideas holding that women deserve equal rights and opportunities, and questioning how gender shapes power in society
example: Feminism came up at the family dinner when Riya asked why only the women were clearing the plates.

hindi: अनुभववाद — ज्ञान का स्रोत इंद्रियों के अनुभव को मानने का मत
definition: the view that knowledge comes mainly from experience gathered through the senses, rather than from reason or ideas we are born with
example: Her empiricism is simple: she will believe the new café makes good coffee once she has tasted it herself.

hindi: विखंडन — पाठ को खोलकर उसके छिपे अंतर्विरोध दिखाने की पद्धति
definition: a method of close reading that pulls apart a text to reveal the contradictions and assumptions hidden beneath its surface meaning
example: Her deconstruction of the wedding invitation revealed that 'casual dress' secretly meant 'dress to impress the aunties'.

hindi: शांतिवाद — युद्ध और हर प्रकार की हिंसा को अनुचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that warfare and violence are never justified and that every dispute should be settled by peaceful means; a less common spelling of pacifism
example: His pacificism extends even to the office table-tennis league, where he refuses to smash on principle.

hindi: अंतरराष्ट्रीयतावाद — राष्ट्रों के आपसी सहयोग को सर्वोपरि मानने का मत
definition: the view that nations should work together closely, because their shared interests matter more than their differences
example: The hostel kitchen, with Korean noodles beside Punjabi pickle, ran on a cheerful internationalism nobody had voted for.

hindi: पूर्णसिद्धि — किसी वस्तु की संभावना का पूरी तरह साकार हो जाना
definition: in Aristotle's philosophy, the state of a thing that has fully become what it had the potential to be, like a seed grown into a towering tree
example: Watching her former intern lead the whole product launch, Sunita felt she was witnessing entelechy in a lanyard.

hindi: स्वतंत्र चिंतन — परंपरा या सत्ता के बजाय तर्क के आधार पर विश्वास बनाने का मत
definition: the view that beliefs, especially about religion, should be formed by reason and evidence rather than accepted from tradition or authority
example: Kiran's freethinking shows at book club, where she refuses to accept any claim just because a bestseller printed it.

hindi: जैवनीतिशास्त्र — चिकित्सा और जीवविज्ञान से उठे नैतिक प्रश्नों का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of ethics that studies moral questions raised by medicine and biology, such as organ donation, gene editing and caring for dying patients
example: The group chat turned into a bioethics seminar when someone asked whether parents should be allowed to edit their baby's genes.

hindi: मानवतावाद — मानव की गरिमा, बुद्धि और कल्याण को केंद्र में रखने वाला मत
definition: the outlook that places human dignity, reason and welfare at the centre, seeking to live well without relying on supernatural authority
example: Her humanism shows in small things: she learns the name of every security guard and asks how their children are doing.

hindi: ब्रह्मांडमीमांसा — ब्रह्मांड की उत्पत्ति और स्वरूप का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the part of philosophy that asks about the origin, structure and nature of the universe as a whole, such as whether it had a beginning
example: Lying on the terrace at midnight, the cousins drifted into cosmology: did the universe begin, or has it always been here?

hindi: परिघटनाविज्ञान — अनुभव जैसा भीतर से प्रतीत होता है, उसका अध्ययन
definition: the study of experience as it feels from the inside, describing how things appear to consciousness before asking what lies behind them; developed by Edmund Husserl
example: Describing exactly how the first sip of monsoon chai feels, rather than measuring its temperature, is a small exercise in phenomenology.

hindi: संशोधनीय — नई जानकारी मिलने पर पुराना निष्कर्ष बदल सकने वाला (तर्क)
definition: describing reasoning in which adding newly learned information can overturn a conclusion that was previously drawn, as everyday reasoning often does
example: Riya's nonmonotonic reasoning kicked in when a friend posted a photo of the empty hall, and the party she had assumed was on was suddenly off.

hindi: अनुमान करना — प्रमाण या तर्क के आधार पर निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: to draw a conclusion from evidence or from statements already accepted, by reasoning rather than being told directly
example: From the empty biscuit tin and the crumbs on his shirt, Mum could infer exactly who had been up at midnight.

hindi: सौंदर्यदृष्टि — क्या सुंदर है, इस पर टिकी विचार-शैली या रुचि
definition: a particular set of ideas or principles about what is beautiful or artistically good, guiding someone's taste and choices; American spelling of aesthetic
example: His apartment follows a strict esthetic: white walls, one plant, and absolutely nowhere to put your bag.

hindi: पुनरुक्ति — अपनी बनावट के कारण ही सदा सत्य रहने वाला कथन
definition: a statement that is true in every possible case purely because of its logical form, such as 'either it will rain or it will not'
example: The weather app's forecast, 'it may or may not rain today', is a tautology dressed up as useful information.

hindi: नीतिनिरपेक्षतावाद — सही-गलत के नैतिक भेदों को ही अमान्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that moral distinctions between right and wrong have no real authority, so moral rules need not guide anyone's choices
example: Rahul claimed amoralism when he grabbed the last parking spot, yet he glared at the driver who did the same to him an hour later.

hindi: अंतरात्मा — सही-गलत का बोध कराने वाली भीतरी आवाज़
definition: the inner sense of right and wrong that judges your own actions and motives, often felt as guilt or unease when you go against it
example: Her conscience kicked in halfway through copying the homework, so she closed the laptop and asked her friend to explain the sums instead.

hindi: अस्तित्ववाद — मनुष्य को पूर्णतः स्वतंत्र और अपने जीवन-अर्थ का रचयिता मानने वाला दर्शन
definition: a twentieth-century movement holding that people are completely free, with no fixed nature, and so fully responsible for creating meaning through their choices
example: Arnav's existentialism phase began the night he realised no aptitude test could choose his career for him.

hindi: मूलमंत्र — किसी व्यक्ति या समूह के आधारभूत सिद्धांत
definition: a short, clear statement of the core beliefs or principles that guide how a person or group thinks and behaves
example: The startup's credo, printed on every mug, is 'ship small, ship often', though the coffee machine has not shipped anything in weeks.

hindi: मूल्यमीमांसा — मूल्यों और मूल्य-निर्णयों का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies value, asking what makes things good, worthwhile or beautiful, and how we judge them
example: Arguing over whether the pricier phone was actually 'worth it', the roommates had stumbled into axiology without realising.

hindi: संभाव्यतावाद — निश्चितता के अभाव में संभावना को आचरण का आधार मानने का मत
definition: the view that certainty is rarely possible, so reasonable belief and action should follow what is probable; in Catholic ethics, the rule that one may follow any well-supported opinion
example: Her probabilism settles most debates: she cannot prove the train will be late, but she packs a snack anyway.

hindi: परिमाणक — 'सब', 'कुछ', 'कोई नहीं' जैसे मात्रा बताने वाले तार्किक शब्द
definition: in logic, a word such as 'every', 'some' or 'none' that tells how many members of a group a statement makes its claim about
example: 'Everyone liked the movie' collapsed the moment Kabir challenged its quantifier, since he had walked out at the interval.

hindi: अभिधारणा — बिना प्रमाण के तर्क का आधार मान ली गई बात
definition: the action of assuming something as true without proof, so that it can serve as a starting point for an argument or theory
example: Every board game night begins with the same postulation: nobody flips the table, however badly Monopoly goes.

hindi: सापेक्षवाद — सत्य और नैतिकता को व्यक्ति, संस्कृति या परिस्थिति के सापेक्ष मानने का मत
definition: the view that truth, knowledge or morality are not absolute but depend on the person, culture or situation making the judgment
example: Invoking relativism to defend pineapple on pizza did not help Sameer, since the whole table shared one very firm standard.

hindi: उन्मूलनवाद — दासप्रथा को पूरी तरह समाप्त करने का आंदोलन और मत
definition: the movement and moral view that slavery must be ended completely, and more broadly that deeply unjust institutions should be abolished
example: In history class, the students traced how abolitionism grew from pamphlets and kitchen-table meetings into a force that changed laws.

hindi: आस्था-घोषणा — अपने विश्वासों और सिद्धांतों का औपचारिक कथन
definition: a formal statement of what a person believes or stands for, setting out their core principles, as in a political testament
example: Her farewell email to the team read like a testament: honest feedback, long lunches, and never a meeting on Friday afternoon.

hindi: अनुकरण सिद्धांत — कला को प्रकृति और जीवन की सच्ची नकल मानने का मत
definition: the theory that paintings, stories and other artworks should faithfully copy nature and the way people really live
example: The director's devotion to imitation meant the actors ate real, cold parathas in every take of the breakfast scene.

hindi: वैराग्यवाद — सांसारिक सुख त्यागकर आत्मिक उन्नति पाने का मार्ग
definition: the view and practice of giving up worldly pleasures and comforts in order to reach a higher spiritual or mental state
example: His month of phone-free asceticism lasted until the cricket final, when he suddenly remembered where he had hidden the phone.

hindi: व्याप्ति-संबंधी — किसी तार्किक शब्द के प्रभाव-क्षेत्र से जुड़ा
definition: relating to scope, meaning how much of a sentence a word like 'every' or 'never' controls, which can change the whole meaning
example: 'Every student didn't pass' has a scopal ambiguity that sent the class group chat into a panic until the teacher clarified.

hindi: रूपवाद — विषयवस्तु से अधिक रूप और संरचना को महत्व देने का मत
definition: the view that form and structure, rather than content or subject matter, are what matter most, especially when judging artworks or mathematics
example: The poetry teacher's formalism meant she graded the sonnet's rhyme scheme first and its heartbreak second.

hindi: प्रत्यक्षवाद — केवल अवलोकन और विज्ञान से सिद्ध ज्ञान को मान्य मानने का मत
definition: the view that genuine knowledge comes only from what can be observed and tested scientifically, rejecting intuition, revelation and speculation as sources
example: Anil's positivism shows at dinner, where he refuses to believe the new diet works until someone shows him an actual study.

hindi: तंत्रिकानीतिशास्त्र — मस्तिष्क-विज्ञान से उठे नैतिक प्रश्नों का अध्ययन
definition: the study of moral questions raised by brain science and brain treatments, such as reading thoughts, boosting memory or altering personality
example: When a startup promised a headband that sharpens focus by zapping your brain, the class debate turned into neuroethics.

hindi: आनुवंशिकतावाद — बुद्धि और स्वभाव को मुख्यतः वंशानुगत मानने का मत
definition: the view that heredity, the traits passed down through genes, matters more than upbringing or surroundings in shaping intelligence and character
example: Uncle's hereditarianism, 'our family is naturally good at maths', did not survive Ishaan's report card.

hindi: संक्रियावाद — किसी अवधारणा का अर्थ उसे मापने की विधि से तय मानने का मत
definition: the view that the meaning of a scientific idea is simply the procedures used to measure or test it, so 'length' means whatever a ruler reports
example: The fitness app's operationalism is blunt: according to it, 'active' simply means ten thousand steps, stairs or no stairs.

hindi: दार्शनिक — अस्तित्व, ज्ञान और नैतिकता के मूल प्रश्नों पर गहराई से विचार करने वाला
definition: a person who studies or thinks deeply about basic questions of existence, knowledge, reality, mind and right action
example: After two cups of cutting chai, the rickshaw driver turned philosopher and asked whether traffic was a punishment or a test.

hindi: अनुकृति — कला और साहित्य में प्रकृति और जीवन का अनुकरण
definition: the imitation or representation of nature and human life in painting, theatre and literature, an idea central to Plato and Aristotle
example: The street play's mimesis was so sharp that the audience recognised their own landlord within seconds.

hindi: व्यक्तिनिष्ठतावाद — ज्ञान और मूल्य को व्यक्ति के अपने अनुभव पर आश्रित मानने का मत
definition: the view that knowledge and values depend on, and are limited by, each person's own experience, feelings and point of view
example: When Neha said the movie was great 'for me', her brother accused her of subjectivism, then admitted he had cried at the end.

hindi: व्याख्येय — जिस तथ्य या कथन की व्याख्या करनी हो
definition: the thing, fact or expression that needs explaining, as opposed to the explanation that is offered for it
example: The explicandum was simple, a missing phone charger, but the family's explanations ranged from the dog to a conspiracy.

hindi: संयमित सुखवाद — भय-मुक्त, सादे आनंद को जीवन का ध्येय मानने वाला यूनानी दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of Epicurus, holding that the goal of life is calm, simple pleasure found in friendship and freedom from fear and pain
example: His epicureanism is modest: good friends, a plate of hot pakoras, and no work emails after seven.

hindi: सुखवाद — सुख को ही सर्वोच्च भलाई मानने का मत
definition: the view that pleasure is the highest good, and that seeking pleasure and avoiding pain is the proper goal of human life
example: Ordering dessert before even glancing at the mains was Tanya's small act of hedonism, and the waiter respected it.

hindi: द्वंद्वात्मक पद्धति — विरोधी तर्कों के टकराव से सत्य तक पहुँचने की विधि
definition: a method of seeking truth through reasoned dialogue, in which opposing arguments are tested against each other until a better view emerges
example: The roommates' nightly dialectic about who should do the dishes has so far produced a rota, a truce and three new arguments.

hindi: अंतःप्रज्ञावाद — ज्ञान, विशेषकर नैतिक ज्ञान, को सीधी अंतर्दृष्टि से प्राप्त मानने का मत
definition: the view that some basic truths, especially moral ones, are grasped directly by intuition, a kind of immediate insight, rather than proved
example: Asked why cheating was wrong, Mira fell back on intuitionism: she just saw it, the way you see that two plus two makes four.

hindi: सिद्धांत — किसी समूह या परंपरा द्वारा मान्य और सिखाया गया मत
definition: a belief or set of beliefs taught and accepted as authoritative by a school of thought, religion or political group
example: In their house, the doctrine that whoever cooks does not wash up has never once been challenged.

hindi: गुणार्थक — शब्द के अर्थ को उसके लक्षणों से जोड़ने वाला
definition: relating to the qualities a word implies, the features something must have to deserve that word, rather than the actual things it names
example: An intensional definition of 'sandwich' lists what makes one, while pointing at the lunch counter merely shows you some.

hindi: धर्मनिरपेक्षता — शासन और सार्वजनिक जीवन को धर्म से अलग रखने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that government, courts and public institutions should stay separate from religion, neither backing nor controlling any faith
example: The school's secularism meant the assembly included songs from every festival, and nobody's holiday got skipped.

hindi: साधनवाद — विचारों और सिद्धांतों को कार्य के साधन मानने का मत
definition: the view that ideas and theories are tools for guiding action and predicting results, judged by how well they work rather than whether they are literally true
example: Priya's instrumentalism about maps is total: she doesn't care whether the app is accurate, only whether it gets her to the metro on time.

hindi: पद्धतिशास्त्र — किसी विषय में ज्ञान खोजने की विधियों और नियमों का अध्ययन
definition: the study of the methods and principles used to investigate questions within a subject, asking which ways of finding things out are reliable
example: The class survey only asked her friends, and the teacher's red ink said one word beside it: methodology.

hindi: पुनर्जन्मवाद — आत्मा के नए शरीर में लौट आने का मत
definition: the belief that after the body dies, the soul or inner self is born again into a fresh body, human or otherwise
example: Grandma's reincarnationism came up at dinner when she insisted the stray dog that visits every Tuesday has her late husband's stubborn streak.

hindi: स्वार्थवाद — अपने हित को ही नैतिकता की कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the ethical view that each person should pursue their own welfare, treating self-interest as the proper basis of morality
example: Arguing that he only returned the lost wallet to feel good about himself, Kabir defended egoism all the way to the metro station.

hindi: व्याख्याकारक — वे कथन जिनसे किसी बात की व्याख्या की जाती है
definition: in logic and science, the group of statements or premises that supply an explanation, as opposed to the explanandum, the fact being explained
example: When the cake sank, 'the oven door was opened too early' became the explanans and the flat sponge the explanandum.

hindi: तर्कशास्त्र — सही अनुमान और प्रमाण के नियमों का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies reasoning itself, working out which arguments have conclusions that genuinely follow from their starting claims
example: The group chat's logic collapsed when someone argued that since pizza is food and salad is food, salad is basically pizza.

hindi: वर्णनवाद — नैतिक कथनों को सच या झूठ हो सकने वाले तथ्य-कथन मानने का मत
definition: in ethics, the view that moral statements describe facts and so can be true or false, just like ordinary factual claims
example: Riya's descriptivism showed when she said 'cheating on the quiz is wrong' is as much a fact as 'the quiz is on Friday'.

hindi: अविनिमेय — जिन्हें आपस में अदला-बदली करने से अर्थ ही बदल जाए
definition: in logic, describing terms that cannot swap places in a statement without changing its meaning, as with 'parent' and 'child'
example: In 'Meera is Arjun's older sister' the two names are noninterchangeable, as Arjun loudly reminds everyone at family dinners.

hindi: व्यवस्थावाद — स्थापित सत्ता और संस्थाओं के समर्थन का मत
definition: the stance of supporting the existing social and political establishment, its institutions and those who hold power; the opposite of antiestablishmentism
example: Dev's establishmentism surfaces every time he defends the housing society committee, even after it banned balcony plants.

hindi: नीतिवाद — नैतिक विचारों को सार्थक और सर्वोपरि मानने का मत
definition: the view that ethics and moral ideas are valid and important, often showing up as a strong habit of judging things morally
example: His ethicism turned a simple choice of breakfast cereal into a ten-minute talk on fair wages for farmers.

hindi: एकपक्षवाद — दूसरे देशों से सलाह लिए बिना विदेश नीति चलाने का मत
definition: the political stance that a nation should handle its foreign affairs alone, without consulting or relying on other countries
example: The flatmate who repainted the kitchen orange without asking anyone was practising pure unilateralism.

hindi: स्वतंत्रार्थक — जो पद अकेले ही वाक्य का उद्देश्य या विधेय बन सके
definition: in logic, describing a word that carries meaning by itself and can stand as the subject of a statement or as what is said about that subject, unlike 'every' or 'and'
example: In 'every student passed', the word 'student' is categorematic, while 'every' only works when propped up by another word.

hindi: विस्तारपरक — शब्द का अर्थ उसके दायरे में आने वाली चीज़ें गिनाकर बताने वाला
definition: describing a definition or meaning given by listing the actual things a word applies to, rather than stating the features they share
example: Asked what 'sibling' means, my nephew gave an extensional answer by simply pointing at his three sisters.

hindi: नीतिशास्त्र — सही-गलत और अच्छे आचरण का दार्शनिक अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies right and wrong, asking how people should live and treat each other
example: A kitchen debate over whether to eat a flatmate's leftovers without asking turned into a full hour of ethics.

hindi: संकेतविज्ञान — चिह्नों और प्रतीकों से अर्थ बनने का अध्ययन
definition: the study of signs and symbols, such as words, gestures, images and emojis, and how they come to carry meaning; also called semiology
example: A lecture on semiotics finally explained why a single thumbs-up emoji from her boss felt quietly terrifying.

hindi: निश्चयात्मक — जो तर्क से अनिवार्यतः सत्य सिद्ध हो
definition: describing a statement that is necessarily true and can be shown with complete certainty, like 'every triangle has three sides'; also spelled apodeictic
example: That seven plus five makes twelve is apodictic, which did not stop my little brother from demanding a recount.

hindi: प्रतिज्ञप्ति — ऐसा कथन जो या तो सच हो या झूठ
definition: in logic, a statement that asserts or denies something and must be either true or false, whatever language it is expressed in
example: 'The milk has gone off' is a proposition, and one sniff at the fridge settled whether it was true.

hindi: नैतिक मूल्य — सही-गलत के वे सिद्धांत जिनसे व्यक्ति का आचरण चलता है
definition: a person's principles about right and wrong, the standards that guide their choices and their sense of what they owe others
example: Her morals were tested when the vending machine dropped two snacks for the price of one.

hindi: तर्कमूलवाद — गणित को शुद्ध तर्कशास्त्र पर टिका मानने का मत
definition: the view that all of mathematics can be built up from pure logic, so that numbers and sums rest on logical rules alone
example: Watching his sister prove that one plus one equals two in forty lines, Aman finally understood what logicism was asking.

hindi: पशुवाद — मनुष्य को मूलतः पशु ही मानने का मत
definition: the view that human beings are purely animals by nature, with no separate spiritual side, so that each person simply is a living organism
example: After three hours without lunch, his snarling at the printer made a strong case for animalism.

hindi: बहिर्गामी — मन की ऐसी क्रिया जिसका असर मन से बाहर पड़े
definition: describing a mental action whose effects pass beyond the mind into the outside world, as opposed to one that stays within it
example: Deciding to text back was immanent, but actually hitting send made it transeunt, and now the whole group knows.

hindi: विरोधाभास — ऐसा कथन जो स्वयं का ही खंडन करता प्रतीत हो
definition: a statement or argument that seems to contradict itself, reaching an absurd conclusion from apparently sensible starting points
example: The office sign reading 'ignore this sign' created a small paradox for everyone waiting at the lift.

hindi: रूढ़ सिद्धांत — बिना प्रमाण के अटल सत्य मान लिया गया मत
definition: a belief or doctrine laid down by an authority as certainly true and not open to question or proof
example: In our office, 'never deploy on Friday' has hardened from sensible advice into dogma.

hindi: निश्चयात्मक — जो अनिवार्यतः और निर्विवाद रूप से सत्य हो
definition: describing a statement that is necessarily true and beyond any doubt, as certain as a proof in geometry; also spelled apodictic
example: The teacher called the claim that a square has four equal sides apodeictic, and the class moved on without argument.

hindi: सुधारवाद — क्रांति के बजाय धीरे-धीरे सुधार से समाज बदलने का मत
definition: the political view that society should be improved through gradual changes within existing institutions rather than by revolution
example: Her reformism showed at the residents' meeting, where she proposed fixing the lift schedule instead of firing the whole committee.

hindi: परिमाणित करना — किसी पद पर 'सभी' या 'कुछ' लगाकर उसका दायरा तय करना
definition: in logic, to mark how much of a group a statement covers by attaching a word like 'every' or 'some' to a term
example: Before the debate on whether teenagers are lazy, the teacher asked us to quantify the claim: all teenagers, or just some?

hindi: लोकवाद — आम जनता को अभिजात वर्ग के विरुद्ध खड़ा करने वाली राजनीति
definition: in political theory, the outlook that pits ordinary people, seen as honest and united, against a corrupt or privileged elite who hold power
example: The class president candidate's populism peaked when he promised to abolish homework on behalf of 'the real students'.

hindi: तत्त्वमीमांसा — अस्तित्व और यथार्थ के मूल स्वरूप का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that asks what reality is fundamentally like, covering existence, time, cause, identity and mind
example: A late-night argument about whether a rebuilt bicycle is still the same bicycle wandered straight into metaphysics.

hindi: सौंदर्यशास्त्र — सौंदर्य, रुचि और कलात्मक मूल्य का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies beauty, taste and artistic value, asking what makes something worth admiring; American spelling of aesthetics
example: Two flatmates arguing over whether the neon cactus lamp is ugly or brilliant are, whether they know it or not, doing esthetics.

hindi: अभिगृहीत — तर्क की नींव के रूप में बिना प्रमाण स्वीकारा गया कथन
definition: in logic and mathematics, a statement accepted as true without proof so that further reasoning can be built upon it
example: The group project began from one shaky postulate: that someone else had already made the slides.

hindi: संकेतविज्ञान — संकेतों द्वारा अर्थ-निर्माण का अध्ययन
definition: the study of signs and how they create meaning in language, fashion, advertising and everyday life; another name for semiotics
example: Her semiology essay argued that a café's handwritten menu board signals 'authentic' far more than it signals 'lunch'.

hindi: द्वैतवाद — यथार्थ को दो मूल तत्त्वों, जैसे मन और पदार्थ, से बना मानने का मत
definition: the view that reality is made of a pair of fundamentally different kinds of thing, usually mind and matter, or sometimes good and evil
example: Insisting that his exhausted body went to the gym while his mind stayed in bed, Nikhil gave a sleepy defence of dualism.

hindi: संक्रामकता — अ-ब और ब-स के संबंध से अ-स का संबंध निकलने का गुण
definition: in logic and mathematics, the property of a relation such that if it links the first thing to the second, and the second to the third, it also links the first to the third
example: Transitivity tells us that if Priya is taller than Sam and Sam is taller than Leo, then Priya is taller than Leo, no measuring tape needed.

hindi: नैतिक संकोच — अंतरात्मा की वह झिझक जो गलत काम से रोके
definition: moral hesitations drawn from one's principles that make a person uneasy about doing something they think may be wrong
example: His scruples kicked in halfway through copying the answers, so he left the group chat and did the homework himself.

hindi: कल्याणवाद — विवेकपूर्ण जीवन से मिलने वाले सच्चे कल्याण को नैतिकता की कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the ethical view that actions are right when they lead to a flourishing life, a lasting well-being reached by living according to reason; also spelled endaemonism
example: Tara's eudemonism made skipping the party easy, since an evening mastering a new guitar song felt like the deeper kind of happiness.

hindi: विधिशास्त्र — कानून के स्वरूप और न्यायिक निर्णयों के आधारों का दर्शन
definition: the philosophy of legal systems, asking what laws are, what gives them authority and what principles guide judges in deciding cases
example: A classroom argument over whether an unfair school rule still counts as a rule turned into a crash course in jurisprudence.

hindi: स्थानसंख्या — किसी संबंध या फलन में भरे जाने वाले खाली स्थानों की गिनती
definition: in logic and mathematics, the number of inputs, or empty slots, that a function or relation needs; 'gives' has three slots, as in 'Asha gives Ravi a book'
example: The relation 'sits between' has an arity of three, which is why the seating chart for the family wedding needed a spreadsheet.

hindi: निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोधवाद — अन्याय का जवाब हिंसा से न देकर सहन करने का मत
definition: the principle of meeting wrongs with passive, nonviolent endurance rather than force, holding that all violence is unjustified; closely related to pacifism
example: When the neighbour's music thumped past midnight, Arjun's passivism meant earplugs and a polite note, not a shouting match.

hindi: व्यवस्था-विरोधवाद — स्थापित सत्ता और संस्थाओं के विरोध का मत
definition: the stance of opposing the existing social and political establishment and distrusting those who hold power; the opposite of establishmentism
example: His antiestablishmentism extends even to the school canteen, where he refuses the official menu on principle.

hindi: प्रस्तुतिपरक — मन के सामने सीधे उपस्थित अनुभव से संबंधित
definition: in philosophy and psychology, relating to what is directly present to the mind in experience, such as colours and sounds, before any interpretation
example: Before she recognised it as her ringtone, the sound was just a presentational blur of chirps in a noisy train carriage.

hindi: शांतिवाद — युद्ध और हिंसा को हर हाल में अनुचित मानने का मत
definition: the view that warfare and violence are never justified and that disputes should be settled by peaceful means; also spelled pacificism
example: Her pacifism faced its toughest test when her little brother stole the last samosa.

hindi: व्यवहारवाद — विचारों के अर्थ और सत्य को उनके व्यावहारिक परिणामों से आँकने का मत
definition: the philosophical view that the meaning and truth of an idea lie in its practical consequences, in what difference believing it makes
example: In a spirit of pragmatism, the flatmates stopped debating who was right about the dishwasher and asked which method left fewer greasy plates.

hindi: कल्याणवाद — सच्चे मानवीय कल्याण को नैतिक कर्म की कसौटी मानने का मत
definition: the ethical view that actions should be judged by whether they lead to a flourishing life, a deep well-being gained by living according to reason; a variant spelling of eudemonism
example: His endaemonism made him quit a well-paid job he hated for a smaller one where he actually looked forward to Mondays.

hindi: अतीन्द्रियवाद — इन्द्रिय-अनुभव से परे अंतर्ज्ञान और आत्मा को प्रधान मानने वाला दर्शन
definition: any philosophy that places intuition and the spiritual above sensory experience and material things, notably a nineteenth-century American movement that prized nature and self-reliance
example: Leaving her phone at home for a weekend of forest walks, Neha joked that she was trying out transcendentalism.

hindi: आधार-कल्पना — तर्क आगे बढ़ाने के लिए सत्य मान लिया गया कथन
definition: in logic, a claim assumed to be true without proof so that an argument or theory can be built on top of it
example: The whole plan for the road trip rested on one posit: that the car would start.

hindi: दर्शन — यथार्थ, ज्ञान और आचरण के मूल प्रश्नों का चिंतन
definition: the study of the deepest questions about reality, knowledge, reason and right conduct; also any guiding system of beliefs held by a person or group
example: Stuck in traffic, the cab driver shared his whole philosophy of life, which mostly involved patience and extra chutney.

hindi: शाब्दिकतावाद — शब्दों या चित्रण को ज्यों-का-त्यों लेने का आग्रह
definition: the practice of taking words at their exact surface meaning, or, in artwork and literature, of portraying things exactly as they appear
example: Told to 'break a leg' before the school play, Ishan's literalism had him double-checking the stage for loose planks.

hindi: मूल सिद्धांत — किसी मत या समूह द्वारा सत्य माना गया बुनियादी विश्वास
definition: a principle or belief held as true by a group, school of thought or movement, often forming part of its core teachings
example: A central tenet of our study group is that nobody opens social media until the first chapter is done.

hindi: समतावाद — सभी मनुष्यों को समान मानने और समान अधिकार देने का मत
definition: the view that all people are equal in worth and should have equal political, economic and social rights and chances; also called equalitarianism
example: The flat's egalitarianism is written on the fridge: everyone takes out the rubbish, landlord's nephew included.

hindi: समतावाद — सबको बराबर हक और अवसर मिलने का मत
definition: the view that all people are of equal worth and deserve the same political, economic and social rights; a less common name for egalitarianism
example: In a burst of equalitarianism, the cricket team decided the captain would carry the kit bag like everyone else.

hindi: एकत्ववाद — समस्त यथार्थ को एक ही मूल तत्त्व से बना मानने का मत
definition: the view that reality is made of a single basic substance or kind of thing, rather than a pair or many
example: Sunita argued for monism over chai, insisting that her thoughts and the biscuit in her hand were ultimately made of the same stuff.

hindi: बहुसंस्कृतिवाद — एक देश में अनेक संस्कृतियों के समान और शांतिपूर्ण सहअस्तित्व का मत
definition: the view that many different cultures can live together peacefully and on equal terms within a single country, each keeping its own traditions
example: The office potluck, with biryani beside sushi beside pierogi, was multiculturalism served on paper plates.

hindi: निगमन करना — दिए गए आधार-वाक्यों से निष्कर्ष तर्कपूर्वक निकालना
definition: to reach a conclusion that must be true if the starting statements are true, by reasoning step by step from general rules
example: All the dosa stalls close at ten and it was half past ten, so Mira deduced that dinner would be instant noodles.

hindi: परिवेशवाद — बौद्धिक विकास में आनुवंशिकता से अधिक परिवेश को निर्णायक मानने का मत
definition: the view that surroundings and upbringing matter more than inherited traits in shaping a person's intelligence and character; the opposite of hereditarianism
example: Pointing out that he only learned to cook after moving in with chefs, Rohan made an easy case for environmentalism.

hindi: शून्यवाद — जीवन, नैतिकता या मूल्यों के किसी वास्तविक आधार को नकारने का मत
definition: the view that life has no built-in meaning or value and that moral rules have no real foundation; historically, also a movement urging the destruction of the existing social order
example: After his third rejected internship application, Varun flirted with nihilism until his mother placed a plate of hot parathas in front of him.

hindi: मनोवाद — मन को ही असली यथार्थ मानने का मत
definition: the view that mind is the true reality and that objects exist only as contents of someone's awareness
example: Staring at the unwashed dishes, Kiran wished his mentalism were strong enough to make them vanish by simply ignoring them.

hindi: आस्था-सूत्र — जीवन को दिशा देने वाले मूल सिद्धांतों का समूह
definition: any system of beliefs or principles that guides how a person or group thinks and lives, whether religious, political or personal
example: Our running club's creed is simple: nobody gets left behind, and nobody brags about their marathon time at breakfast.

hindi: प्राणवाद — जीवन को भौतिकी-रसायन से परे किसी विशेष प्राण-शक्ति से चलता मानने का मत
definition: the view that living things are driven by a special life force that cannot be fully explained by physics and chemistry
example: Watching the wilted basil perk up an hour after watering, Pooja joked that her windowsill was making the case for vitalism.

hindi: अंतर्वर्ती — जो मन के भीतर ही घटे और बाहर असर न डाले
definition: describing a mental action that takes place wholly within the mind, such as thinking or wishing, without producing effects outside it; more broadly, present within something
example: Silently rehearsing a comeback on the bus is immanent; saying it aloud to the man hogging two seats is another matter entirely.

hindi: प्रयोगवाद — ज्ञान और विचारों को प्रयोग द्वारा परखने का आग्रह
definition: the view that ideas and beliefs should be tested through experiment and experience, closely linked to pragmatism in education and science
example: In a fit of experimentalism, the flatmates timed three different ways of boiling pasta instead of arguing about it.

hindi: व्याख्येय — वह तथ्य या घटना जिसकी व्याख्या की जानी है
definition: in logic and science, the fact, event or statement that needs explaining, as opposed to the explanans, which does the explaining
example: The explanandum at breakfast was simple: why was the milk carton in the cupboard, and who was going to confess?

hindi: प्रयोजनवाद — वस्तुओं और घटनाओं को उनके उद्देश्य या लक्ष्य से समझाने का मत
definition: the practice of explaining things by the goals or purposes they serve, as in saying that eyes exist for seeing
example: Claiming that the office coffee machine exists purely to test his patience, Farhan slipped into grumpy teleology.

hindi: सृष्टिवाद — ब्रह्मांड और जीवों को किसी दैवी सृष्टिकर्ता की रचना मानने का मत
definition: the belief that the universe and living beings were made by a divine creator, often as described in scripture such as the Book of Genesis, rather than through evolution alone
example: A biology lesson on evolution became a respectful discussion of creationism when a student asked how the two views compare.

hindi: पृथकतावाद — किसी क्षेत्र या समूह के राज्य से अलग होने के अधिकार का समर्थन
definition: in political theory, the view that a region or group has the right to break away from a larger state and govern itself
example: When the top floor of the hostel threatened to run its own Wi-Fi network, the warden sensed a whiff of secessionism.

hindi: संकल्पनावाद — सामान्य शब्दों को मन की संकल्पनाओं से जुड़ा मानने का मत
definition: the view that a general word like 'chair' fits many different objects because the mind forms a concept linking them, rather than because some shared 'chairness' exists outside minds
example: Debating whether a beanbag counts as a chair, the class drifted into conceptualism: maybe 'chair' just lives in our heads.

hindi: सौंदर्यदृष्टि — सुंदरता के बारे में कोई विशेष सिद्धांत या रुचि
definition: a particular theory or sense of what is beautiful or artistically pleasing, as held by a person, movement or style; also spelled esthetic
example: Her room follows a strict minimalist aesthetic, which mostly means her clothes live in a pile inside the wardrobe.

hindi: प्रत्ययवाद — यथार्थ को मूलतः मानसिक या विचारमय मानने का मत
definition: the view that reality is fundamentally made of minds and ideas, so that the physical world depends on being thought or perceived
example: On the walk to school Kunal tried out idealism, wondering whether the traffic jam existed only because everyone kept thinking about it.

hindi: ज्ञानमीमांसा — ज्ञान के स्वरूप, स्रोत और सीमाओं का अध्ययन
definition: the branch of philosophy that studies knowledge itself: what it is, where it comes from and how we can tell it apart from mere belief
example: A forwarded message about a miracle cure sparked some family-chat epistemology when Aunt Meena asked how anyone actually knew it worked.

hindi: व्युत्पन्न करना — स्वीकृत आधारों से तर्क द्वारा कोई निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: in logic, to obtain a conclusion from starting statements by applying accepted rules of reasoning, step by step
example: From the rule that phones stay off at dinner and the sight of Dad scrolling, Riya derived a clear case of hypocrisy.

hindi: भौतिकवाद — हर अस्तित्व को अंततः भौतिक मानने का मत
definition: the view that everything that exists is ultimately physical, so that even thoughts and feelings are nothing beyond physical processes
example: Clutching his coffee, Aryan argued for physicalism, claiming his morning mood was nothing more than brain chemistry awaiting caffeine.

hindi: विमर्शात्मक — अंतर्ज्ञान के बजाय क्रमबद्ध तर्क से निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने वाला
definition: describing thinking that reaches a conclusion through step-by-step reasoning and argument rather than through direct intuition
example: Her dianoetic approach to choosing a phone involved a spreadsheet, three columns of pros and cons and zero gut feeling.
